analysis.summary: Macpower CNC Machines Limited reported its highest-ever quarterly and half-yearly performance in Q2 and H1 FY27 across revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management increased its annual revenue growth guidance to nearly 35% for the year and expects a sustainable 25% to 30% growth trajectory over the next three years. Construction of new capacity on newly acquired land has begun to support future growth, backward integration, and debottlenecking. The pending order book stood robust at INR 476 crores, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth. Macpower CNC reported record financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by strong operational execution and demand for its high-precision CNC machines.

guidance.claim: Management increased the annual growth guidance for the year to nearly 35%.
guidance.quote: I think in last first quarter we committed 30% growth and I think we delivered that growth in quarter 2 and now I am increasing our guidance for this year growth is nearly 35%.

guidance.claim: The guidance for the coming three years is 25% to 30% growth.
guidance.quote: FY27 and FY28, I think we will continue our growth journey like 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to exceed 20% in the future once new capacity and backward integration are fully realized.
guidance.quote: Definitely it will increase by, gradually it will increase, but definitely it will be more than 20%.

guidance.claim: Management guided for over thirty-five percent revenue growth for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with a strong order book of Rs. 476 crore, an expanding high-end product portfolio and ongoing capacity investments, we are confident of delivering another year of robust growth and are guiding for +35% revenue growth for the current financial year.

guidance.claim: Management confirmed delivering another year of robust growth of over 30% due to a strong order book, expanding high-end product portfolio, and ongoing CapEx.
guidance.quote: Future guidance with the strong order book of INR456 crore, almost y-o-y 32% grown by last year to this year. And expanding high-end product portfolio and ongoing CapEx, we are - confirm our delivering another year of robust growth and are looking at plus 30%.

guidance.claim: Management increased the growth target to 30-plus percentage for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we are slightly we are increasing our growth target by 30-plus percentage in this coming year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company experienced strong demand and a robust order pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust order book and strong demand on pipeline.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has not faced significant pricing resistance due to global conditions and domestic advantages.
demand_outlook.quote: Right now, there is no resistance because of the global situation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted sustained demand momentum for high-precision CNC machines.
demand_outlook.quote: These results reflect robust operational execution, sustained demand momentum for our high-precision CNC machines, and disciplined progress on strategic initiatives.

demand_outlook.claim: Pending order book for quarter one stands at INR456 crore, reflecting a 32% year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust order book and strong demand in pipeline, pending order book of quarter one stands at INR456 crore, reflecting 32% y-o-y growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic bids submitted stood at INR739 crore.
Tender bids under evaluation stood at INR304 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Tender bid under evolution INR304 crores and domestic quotations is in pipeline for INR1,000-plus crore INR1,043 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: CapEx during the quarter was INR 2.89 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: CapEx during the quarter was INR 2.89 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Development work for four new technical centres in Kolhapur, Mumbai, Chennai, and Aurangabad is underway and expected to be operational in the third quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Development work in our upcoming 4 tech centres in Kolhapur, Mumbai, Chennai and Aurangabad is underway and we will expect to be operational in third quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured thirteen acres of industrial land on a thirty-year lease for long-term manufacturing expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: • 13 acres of industrial land secured on a 30-year lease.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned capital investment execution timeline is targeted for completion within twelve months.
Construction of new capacity on the thirteen-acre land at Chhapra has commenced and is expected to become operational by Q2 FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of new capacity on the 13-acre land at Chhapra has commenced and is expected to become operational by Q2 FY28, enabling de-bottlenecking, backward integration and significant scaling.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex during the quarter was two point eight nine crore rupees.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex during the quarter was Rs. 2.89 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: CapEx during quarter one was INR2.25 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: CapEx during quarter one was INR2.25 crore, internal CapEx has led to corresponding increase in depreciation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company selected 13 acres of land on a 30 years long-term lease near its existing plant for infrastructure expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our aggressive growth strategy and sustained momentum in order flow, we have selected 13 acres, 9 plus 4 for green zone of land on a 30 years long term, legally registered lease near our existing plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The new assembly facility shop floor will be approximately 1.5 lakh to 2 lakh square feet and centrally air-conditioned.
capex_expansion.quote: State-of-the-art assembly facility will be centrally air- conditioned, shop floor on approximately 1.5 lakh to 2 lakh square feet.

capex_expansion.claim: The targeted completion of the new facility is within 12 months with an estimated investment of INR50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Targeted completion of this facility within 12 months. Estimated investment of this expansion is INR50 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion benefits from the Vikshit Gujarat New Industrial Policy 2026 including a 25% capital subsidy plus a 7% interest subsidy.
capex_expansion.quote: Benefit of this expansion from Vikshit Gujarat New Industrial Policy 2026 is including 25% capital subsidy plus 7% interest subsidy.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 16.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR 19.94 crores with growth of 40.8% y-o-y with EBITDA margin of 16.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 11.2%, up by 26 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Net profit margin stood at 11.2% up plus 26 bps y-o-y for the quarter ended.

margins_costs.claim: Incremental CapEx has led to a corresponding increase in depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Incremental CapEx has led to a corresponding increase in depreciation.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter was sixteen point five seven percent.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was Rs. 19.94 crore, growing 40.8% YoY with a healthy margin of 16.57%.

margins_costs.claim: Average machine realization remained healthy at around twenty point three six lakh rupees.
margins_costs.quote: For H1 FY27, revenue reached Rs. 215.56 crore, up 46.9% YoY. Average machine realization remained healthy at around Rs. 20.36 lakh.

margins_costs.claim: Management increased product prices by 4% to 6% effective from 1st June.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, definitely, we increased the price by 4% to 6% and this first quarter we had given chance, to our customer, who have given the order, that if you are not lifting the machine, you are to you are eligible to give us 4% to 6% new price increment.

risks_headwinds.quote: If this kind of machine is used in the defence purpose, then our entire production line will choke up because some of the European and Japanese companies will not give us the material.
